E4Plus1.uk.description: The Bet: Peralta and Santiago's ongoing bet about who can make the most arrests comes to an awkward conclusion. Boyle gets a medal after he's shot in the line of duty. (S1 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Ebony Falcon: Sergeant Jeffords returns to the field and goes undercover at a gym with Peralta and Boyle to investigate steroid trafficking. (S1 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sandra Dee's: In California, Gordon helps out barbecue and seafood restaurant Sandra Dee's, by updating the 20-year-old dining room's decor and overhauling the kitchen and menu. (S1 Ep8) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Musical Man: Cameron relishes being interim music director at Luke and Manny's school, but takes on the upcoming spring musical with a little too much zest and passion. (S2 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Someone to Watch Over Lily: Mitchell and Cameron secretly weigh up who in the family could be suitable legal guardians for Lily if anything ever happened to them. (S2 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: In Cornwall, there are Friesian cows, pitchforks and zombie apocalypse advice, in an eclectic edition of the dining competition.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Catfish Cabin: Gordon visits Catfish Cabin in Tennessee, where waning staff morale is causing problems. Can the team overhaul the dark interior and tired menu in just 24 hours? (S2 Ep4) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Stone's Throw: Gordon Ramsay visits Stone's Throw, a family-owned fine dining restaurant on the Housatonic River in Connecticut, to overhaul the drab interior and revamp the menu. (S2 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck Mediterranean
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The charter season draws to a close, but not before two crewmembers double down on a terrible decision... (S10 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Moving Day: Claire and Phil aren't convinced that Haley and Dylan can make it on their own when they move them into their new apartment before the baby arrives. (S10 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Blasts from the Past: Phil and Claire decide to take a cycling tour through Italy before becoming grandparents, and Dylan introduces them to his mum, who has an interesting past. (S10 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Boy-Scoutz 'n the Hood: During an all-syrup Squishee bender, Bart joins the junior campers and ends up taking the embarrassing - and dangerous - Homer on a river rafting trip. (S5 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: $pringfield (or How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Legalized Gambling): Homer gets a job at Mr Burns' new casino and Marge gets addicted to the slot machines. (S5 Ep10/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer the Vigilante: Homer sets up a chaotic vigilante group to combat one-man crime spree Molloy (guest star Sam Neill). (S5 Ep11/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Trilogy of Error: Homer gets his thumb sliced off while trying to steal a brownie. Lisa misses the school bus. Bart discovers Fat Tony's stash of smuggled fireworks. (S12 Ep18/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bureau: Pimento's life is still in peril, so Captain Holt calls on an old friend in the FBI to help identify the crooked agent who tried to have him killed. (S3 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Greg and Larry: The squad drop everything when they realise that Holt is in danger as the search for Pimento's hitman takes an unexpected turn. (S3 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Last Christmas: Cameron hopes to keep everyone happy for Christmas dinner, but Mitchell thinks he has an ulterior motive. Meanwhile, Claire tries to dodge Jay's job offer. (S11 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Prescott: Alex's new company puts her up in a luxury apartment with full amenities and famous neighbours - and the family are keen to make the most of it... (S11 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Legacy: Phil visits his dad to make sure he's OK after hearing some concerning news. Meanwhile, Jay gives Claire and Mitch a bunch of their old childhood memorabilia. (S11 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dead on a Rival: Mitchell learns a valuable life lesson when Murray shows up unexpectedly. And the Dunphys' old neighbour Kenneth, who's now a tech titan, visits. (S11 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mountain of Madness: An avalanche traps Homer and Mr Burns in a mountain cabin during a team-building exercise. (S8 Ep12/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Simpsoncalifragilisticexpiala (Annoyed Grunt) cious: Supernanny Shary Bobbins comes to the rescue of Marge, who is so stressed that her hair has started to fall out. (S8 Ep13/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Itchy & Scratchy & Poochie Show: Homer gets a job on The Itchy & Scratchy Show as the voice of hip-hop surfer dog Poochie, a character brought in to boost viewing figures. (S8 Ep14/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer's Phobia: Homer's prejudices surface when Bart befriends a gay shop owner (guest star John Waters). So he decides to take Bart hunting - but it doesn't go to plan. (S8 Ep15/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart-Mangled Banner: The family are arrested after Bart accidentally moons the American flag and Marge says on national television that all of Springfield hates America. (S15 Ep21/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dangers on a Train: While she's browsing for wedding anniversary cakes, Marge stumbles across a website for married people who want to have affairs. (S24 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: It's a chaotic start to the charter season for Captain Kerry, thanks to a seasick chef, some novice crewmembers, and a demanding germaphobe guest. (S12 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: What do the Goggleboxers think of Line of Duty, Celebrity Bake Off, The Flight Attendant, Teen First Dates, The Circle, Remarkable Places to Eat, and Matt Hancock on This Morning? (S17 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: What do Britain's sharpest armchair critics think of Line of Duty, This Is My House, The Proof Is Out There, Formula 1: Drive to Survive, Countdown and This Morning? (S17 Ep5)
